# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/7fd45428-e31b-495a-9379-d29b01f29e38/logo?v=1756138558)    FMN Creative, LLCDigital Marketing Intern  Remote  ·   Part time      [Apply for Digital Marketing Intern](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/fmn-creative-llc-digital-marketing-intern-5c81ce01-fbee-4dfa-9b88-265bf068e179/applicants/new)

Become a Digital Marketing Intern and explore the exciting world of digital advertising, branding, and storytelling as your work on diverse agency and client projects, honing your skills in social media, copywriting, and campaign development, all while earning valuable college credits. If you're a proactive, creative-thinker with a passion for digital marketing and a knack for multitasking, this opportunity is perfect for you.

### About FMN Creative, LLC

FMN Creative is a growing Social Media Agency looking for creative professionals to join our roster of talent. We are a full-service agency and handle everything that clients don't see behind a social media posts. From strategy to content creation, email marketing, web building, and more, we truly turn clicks into customers and handle all of the nuances on (and off) social media.

### Description

**Digital Marketing Intern**

Join our team as a Digital Marketing Intern and immerse yourself in the dynamic world of digital advertising, branding, and storytelling. This 12-week internship offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience working on agency and client projects in a fast-paced agency environment while earning college credits. Does this sound like you?

**Our Ideal ‘Socialite’:**

- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, or related field, AND must be able to earn college credits for work experience
- Passionate about digital marketing, branding, and story telling – social media, email marketing, copywriting, blogging, etc.
- Rockstar multi-tasker that can prioritize
- Have personal and professional social media exposure and/or experience
- Possess a flair for a perfectly written social media post with visual and content appeal
- Critical and creative-thinker with a desire to think outside the box
- Enthusiastic, driven, proactive, and willing to bring new ideas to the table
- Outgoing personality and communication skills are a must
- Familiarity with social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.) and WordPress is a plus
- Passion for music is a HUGE bonus
- Resides in the CNY Region

**Responsibilities Include:**

- Availability to work up to 10 hours per week, in-person and/or remotely
- Must be able to commit to a minimum of 12 weeks or longer based upon college credit requirements
- Working on various projects for the agency and clients, including research, blogging, copywriting, social media management, campaign ideation and development, lead generation and nurturing
- Assist in the planning and social media coverage of workshops and events, as needed
- Assist in the curation and content creation of our agency’s Monthly Mix, which is our monthly playlist, blog, and email newsletter

**Outcomes:**

_By the end of this internship, you’ll be able to add the following to your resume:_

- Have a thorough understanding of the inner-workings of a digital agency
- Experience in digital marketing and advertising, including social media, e-course creation, sales funnels, and email marketing
- Analyze and draw conclusions from digital data
- Familiarity with WordPress, MailChimp, Facebook for Business, and a variety of digital tools
- Ability to build a digital sales funnel and understand tactics at each stage of customer acquisition

[Apply for Digital Marketing Intern](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/fmn-creative-llc-digital-marketing-intern-5c81ce01-fbee-4dfa-9b88-265bf068e179/applicants/new)
